english.note: Use this strongly derogatory term for Koreans when the explicitly ethnic-slur force matters more than everyday Cantonese phrasing.

examples.english: This newspaper actually used the slur gook for Koreans and was heavily criticized.
examples.traditional: 呢份報紙竟然用「高麗棒子」稱呼韓國人，俾人鬧到臭。
